title: Merged Prototype1b peer evidence and DataStorage stage isolation
mode: Primary-source cross-project research and implementation-plan refinement
scope: Refresh the ACadSharp Prototype1b/DataStorage parser evidence and distinguish section parsing, Blob01 reconstruction, entity wiring, payload preservation, and geometry semantics.
Cross-check the peer evidence against ODA v5.4.1, current LibreDWG source/report, Autodesk DXF/ObjectARX documentation, FreeCAD's current DXF route, and OCCT shape-validity documentation.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 and PAR-14 procedures while preserving fast local validation, existing fixture policy, LibreCAD 2D compatibility, and external evidence ceilings.

sources.revision: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, sections 24.2.2.3-24.2.2.4; read as the project's authoritative DWG-layout source.
sources.observed: Documents DWG AcDs/DataStorage record and Blob01 layout used by the local reader plan.
sources.limits: Peer discussion alleges an empirical formula/anchor conflict; the allegation does not supersede the repository's instruction that ODA v5.4.1 is authoritative. Any local exception needs a versioned sample trace and explicit evidence.

sources.revision: PR #1154 merged into master on 2026-07-28; current master source and PR #1156 closure/review thread inspected 2026-10-20. No release artifact was run.
sources.observed: The merged parser models the full Prototype1b section; #1156 was closed after the merged ResolveDataEntry route was reported to cover Blob01 reassembly. The review thread separates full section parsing, entity wiring, referenced versus stale/unreferenced entries, and exact payload hashes. Current source shows a schema type-size array access without a visible range check.
sources.limits: Mutable source and contributor comments are not a bound package run or independent semantic result. The old parser branch had a reported stale secondary index failure; that is a comparator qualification lead, not a claim that a current release fails. Source-level array access is not a reproduced vulnerability.

sources.revision: Mutable current source, NEWS, and issue #1411 inspected 2026-10-20; no peer build or sample executed.
sources.observed: Issue #1411 describes an AC1027+ AcDs/SAB carrier-loss route. Current source has an AcDs reader path and NEWS describes modern extraction as incomplete/heuristic, so the report is route/profile-specific rather than proof of no reader implementation.
sources.limits: Issue report and current source are different evidence; no result establishes current-master behavior or libdxfrw support.

sources.revision: Public documentation pages inspected 2026-10-20; no native application or kernel run.
sources.observed: Autodesk describes AcDb3dSolid as a container/interface over ShapeManager; the public DXF table documents inline proprietary group 1/3 data. FreeCAD documents that its stock DXF importer cannot read ACIS/SAT blobs and that DWG conversion precedes DXF import. OCCT BRepCheck_Analyzer checks validity of shapes.
sources.limits: Neither a FreeCAD open nor an OCCT validity result alone proves source-to-output geometric equivalence, DWG association, or behavior on an unselected platform/build.

sources.revision: Existing PAR-07/S8 and PAR-14 procedures and generated DataStorage test owners inspected and refined 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The plan now requires a live index/reference-to-entity join and per-payload digest rather than aggregate counts; existing generated direct/blob, schema-boundary, and stale-index controls are reused.
sources.limits: No local code or tests were changed or run; no external fixture was added.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: compare modern AcDs payloads through current-header index, live segment/data/schema references, exact record/page bytes, and entity-handle association; do not compare aggregate counts alone.
PAR-07/S8: ACadSharp #1154 is an optional pinned reader-stage comparator, not write support, semantic evidence, or proof that mutable master/released packages pass.
PAR-14: local malformed schema-type and stale-index tests remain local generated controls; do not duplicate completed coverage or run hostile mutation inputs against an unqualified peer.
PAR-07/S8: ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG layout; peer-reported discrepancies require exact versioned sample traces before any exception is considered.
Consumer/semantic gate: FreeCAD explicit/2D entity acceptance, ACIS carrier preservation, parser profile, kernel validity, and independent geometric expectations remain separate results.

planChanges: Added a precise optional ACadSharp Prototype1b comparator boundary based on merged #1154 and closed #1156, while keeping release/source pinning mandatory.
Replaced aggregate DataStorage payload-count comparison with a live index/schema/record/Blob01/entity-handle join and per-payload hashes.
Separated stale/unreferenced segment records and pre-2013 inline payloads from live referenced AcDs payloads.
Recorded peer source-level robustness leads without calling them reproduced vulnerabilities or adding peer hostile-input runs.
Reaffirmed ODA v5.4.1 authority and required versioned sample-trace evidence before accepting a peer-reported specification discrepancy.
Kept local generated fast tests, fixture policy, sparse full suites, FreeCAD 2D compatibility, and all six deferred J items unchanged.
limitations: GitHub master/issue pages are mutable. ACadSharp PR history is source/review evidence, not evidence from a current released package executed here.
No ACadSharp or LibreDWG executable/package, native CAD application, geometry kernel, external drawing, or test corpus was run or downloaded.
ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG layout. Peer discussion about a possible spec error is only a hypothesis until validated against the relevant ODA text and a supported-version sample trace.
No new local finding, implementation slice, test, fixture, dependency, claim promotion, or J-item transition was established.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
